ACE Dell Control technical preview dependency manifest

Runtime files installed by this package:

- DellFanCmd.exe 2.1.1, DellFanLib.dll 2.1.1, and
  DellSetThermalSetting.exe 2.1.1: GPL-3.0, Aaron Kelley.
  Project and corresponding release source:
  https://github.com/AaronKelley/DellFanManagement
  All three installed binaries match the official 2.1.1 release assets
  byte-for-byte (SHA-256 comparison).

- bzh_dell_smm_io_x64.sys: GPL-3.0, 424778940z.
  Source snapshot:
  https://github.com/424778940z/bzh-windrv-dell-smm-io/tree/67786c69a80f2dd3e0d948cfaba6ced6c2c090e3
  The installed binary matches the official DellFanCmd 2.1.1 asset
  byte-for-byte and Windows 11 reports its Aaron Kelley signature as valid.
  Its PE build timestamp is 2015-09-05; the source code did not change
  between that date and the archived 2016 snapshot (only LICENSE was added).
  Rebuilding a bit-identical driver has not been attempted.

- LibreHardwareMonitorLib.dll 0.9.6: MPL-2.0.
  Source: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/releases/tag/v0.9.6
  The library includes PawnIO.Modules 0.2.2 modules under LGPL-2.1.
  Source: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/releases/tag/0.2.2
  (Tag commit e12a858d952461ee2e919897cacbff7f905fe370)
  ACE enables only CPU hardware in this library. RAM usage and fan RPM are
  obtained independently, so unrelated LHM libraries are not distributed.
  The installed DLL matches the official v0.9.6 release asset byte-for-byte.

- Costura.Fody 4.1.0: MIT, merged into DellFanCmd.exe.
  Source: https://github.com/Fody/Costura
  (NuGet package https://www.nuget.org/packages/Costura.Fody/4.1.0)

- System.Memory.dll 4.6.3, System.Buffers.dll 4.6.1,
  System.Numerics.Vectors.dll 4.6.1, and
  System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe.dll 6.1.2: MIT,
  .NET Foundation and contributors. Their file hashes match the net462
  binaries in the corresponding official NuGet packages:
  https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Memory/4.6.3
  https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Buffers/4.6.1
  https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Numerics.Vectors/4.6.1
  https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe/6.1.2

Full license texts are in the licenses folder. Source snapshots for the
copyleft components are in the source folder. This manifest is a technical
inventory, not a legal clearance certificate.
